title: Give the lead Jenkins tunnel a health verdict and detached restart
body:
Outcome: the lead Jenkins tunnel reports and repairs its own health: a command prints `tunnel: up|down (<cause>)` and restarts it detached, so Jenkins reads never fail with ECONNREFUSED mid-slice.
Evidence 2026-11-05: .krn/runs/ci-platform/lead-access/tunnel.mjs died twice ("Connection timed out during banner exchange"; a child of the Bash tool was killed); restarting with nohup+disown worked.
Proof: a test of the health verdict against a closed port.
